Name: Kenneth's Hearty Breakfast and Grill
Author: Kf29
Description:
Adds 67 custom hearty breakfast & grill dishes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51313]Kenneth's Restaurant[/url] - fluffy eggs and folded omelets, creamy bowls and buttery pastas, sizzling steaks and BBQ plates, rustic stews and woodfired pizzas - each with its own kitchen recipe!

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51313]Kenneth's Restaurant[/url] - this mod's items are sold in its Shop2 and Shop3.

Customization: By default, all 67 dishes appear in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51313]Kenneth's Restaurant[/url]. If you want to customize your selection and have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] installed, you can disable individual dishes to remove them from the shops along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a dish restores it to the shops and its recipe to your kitchen.

More details can be found in ReadMe.txt.

Please do not reupload this mod or include it in modpacks without permission.
